description: Capability for the small LOCAL updater window (label `updater`), which is bundled with the app rather than served by the central API. It needs core event + window defaults so it can receive `updater://state` progress events and close itself. It is deliberately NOT granted `updater:default`: the update check, download, signature verification and install are all driven from Rust, and the three `updater_*` commands additionally reject any caller whose window label is not `updater` — so the remote Creator Portal in the `main` window can never trigger an install.
